sonnet.problem: This story card has three sentences, and every story card after the opening card is limited to 1 to 2 sentences. It also carries more than two beats: the boundaries, Sihon and Og's kingdoms, and Moses striking them down.
sonnet.rule: **Every other story card, including the first card of a later stop, is 1 to 2 sentences.**

sonnet.problem: The setup says 'Sihon and Og are gone, but the Geshurites and Maacathites get a line all their own.' The 'but' and the 'line all their own' signal that these groups were treated differently, which rules out the wrong answer 'True'.
sonnet.rule: A setup line can't rule out the wrong answers either.

sonnet.problem: 'Not one field. Not one hill. NOT ONE ACRE.' stretches the text's 'no inheritance' into a loud exaggeration. It is not one of Papa Dorin's jokes, and the Levites later receive cities and pasturelands (Joshua 21).
sonnet.rule: **Don't stretch the text.** Exaggerate only in his own jokes.

sonnet.rule: When a line repeats in the passage, like a psalm's refrain, ask about it only the first time it appears in this passage.
